title: Replace broken category icons with local SVG assets and resilient fallback rendering

requirements.summary: Add local SVG icon assets for all homepage categories and all Local Skilled Workers subcategories under frontend/public/assets/generated, with no external icon URLs.
acceptanceCriteria: All category and subcategory icons used by the UI resolve to local paths under /assets/generated/ and do not reference any external URL.
All new icon files are SVGs and are committed as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated.
The app builds successfully and category/subcategory icons render without broken image placeholders in the browser.

requirements.summary: Update homepage category icon paths and Local Skilled Workers subcategory icon paths to reference the new local SVG filenames under /assets/generated/.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx category icon paths reference .svg files under /assets/generated/ (not .png).
frontend/src/config/localSkilledWorkers.ts subcategory icon paths reference .svg files under /assets/generated/ (not .png).
No remaining references to the old icon .png filenames are required for correct rendering of category/subcategory icons.

file_operations.description: Replace the homepage categories array icon paths to use the local SVG assets (e.g., /assets/generated/icon-construction.dim_128x128.svg) instead of .png references; ensure the Local Skilled Workers subcategory default icon references are also updated to local .svg paths.

Update Local Skilled Workers taxonomy icon paths so every subcategory points to its specific local SVG file under /assets/generated/ (e.g., icon-rope-maker.dim_128x128.svg, icon-tailor.dim_128x128.svg) and update helper fallback return values to .svg paths.

requirements.summary: Add robust local fallback icon behavior so missing/empty/failed icon loads render a local fallback SVG without changing the existing layout.
acceptanceCriteria: On the homepage category grid, when an icon fails to load, the UI displays the fallback icon (the icon is not hidden).
On the Local Skilled Workers subcategory grid, when an icon fails to load, the UI displays the fallback icon.
Fallback uses a local SVG file under /assets/generated/ and does not load from any external URL.
The fallback behavior does not change spacing, sizing, or layout of the existing category/subcategory cards (only the image source changes).

file_operations.description: Create a small shared SafeIconImage component that renders an with resilient local fallback handling (treat missing/empty src as fallback, and swap to fallback on load error) while preserving passed sizing/className; use local fallback at /assets/generated/icon-fallback.dim_128x128.svg.

Wire SafeIconImage into the homepage category grid and Local Skilled Workers subcategory grid, replacing current onError behavior that hides the image; ensure fallback uses /assets/generated/icon-fallback.dim_128x128.svg and keep existing wrapper divs/classes unchanged to avoid layout changes.

Update getSubcategoryIcon (and any default icon constants used for Local Skilled Workers) to return the local fallback SVG path /assets/generated/icon-fallback.dim_128x128.svg when the icon is missing/empty or no match is found, without changing any UI layout logic.
